import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] C;
    static int r, c;
    static long total;
    static long best = (long) 1e18, best_z = -1;
    static String s;
    static int[] cntA, cntB;
    static Map<Long, Long> mp;

    static void dfs(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long diff = Math.abs(x - y);
        if (best <= 1 || diff - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] >= best) return;
        if (v1 == r - 1 && v2 == r - 1) {
            long diff2 = Math.abs(x - y);
            if (diff2 < best) {
                best = diff2;
                best_z = x;
            }
            return;
        }
        if (v1 >= r) {
            long cur1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r];
            long sum2 = C[v2][r];
            dfs(x, y + cur1 * sum2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 >= r) {
            long sum1 = C[v1][r];
            long cur2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
            dfs(x + sum1 * cur2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
    }

    static long solve(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long state = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
        if (mp.containsKey(state)) return mp.get(state);
        long res = 0;
        long diff = Math.abs(x - y);
        if (diff - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] > best) {
            mp.put(state, res);
            return res;
        }
        if (v1 < r || v2 < r) {
            int sum = v1 + v2;
            if (v1 >= cntA[sum] && v2 >= cntB[sum]) {
                v1 -= cntA[sum];
                v2 -= cntB[sum];
                res = C[v1 + v2][v1];
                mp.put(state, res);
                return res;
            }
            mp.put(state, res);
            return res;
        }
        res = 0;
        char c = s.charAt(v1 + v2 - 1);
        if (c != 'B') {
            long cur1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r];
            long sum2 = C[v2][r];
            res += solve(x, y + cur1 * sum2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (c != 'A') {
            long sum1 = C[v1][r];
            long cur2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
            res += solve(x + sum1 * cur2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
        mp.put(state, res);
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        r = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int size = 2 * (r + c) + 1;
        C = new long[size][size];

        for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (r + c); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 2 * (r + c); j++) {
                if (j == 0) C[i][j] = 1;
                else if (i == 0) C[i][j] = 0;
                else C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1];
            }
        }

        total = C[r + c][r] * C[r + c][r];

        long x = 0, y = 0;
        int v1 = r + c, v2 = r + c;
        while (v1 >= r && v2 >= r) {
            if (x > y) {
                long cur1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r];
                long sum2 = C[v2][r];
                y += cur1 * sum2;
                v1--;
            } else {
                long sum1 = C[v1][r];
                long cur2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
                x += sum1 * cur2;
                v2--;
            }
        }
        best = Math.abs(x - y);

        dfs(0, 0, r + c, r + c);

        s = br.readLine();
        cntA = new int[2 * (r + c) + 1];
        cntB = new int[2 * (r + c) + 1];

        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (r + c); i++) {
            cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (s.charAt(i) == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (s.charAt(i) == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }

        mp = new HashMap<>();
        long ans = solve(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
